subject.title: fix(agent): duplicate same-session turn when the gateway connection drops after accepting a run

question: Should accepted non-transient gateway disconnects continue using immediate fresh-session embedded reruns, or should this PR wait for reattach-first recovery policy?
rationale: The patch fixes the narrow transcript collision, but it deliberately preserves double execution, tool-side-effect, result-divergence, and possible duplicate-delivery behavior; repository policy treats fallback behavior as a product decision.

options.title: Land the narrow isolation fix
options.body: After breaking the import cycle, preserve recook-first for now and keep https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/98200 as the canonical reattach-first policy discussion.

options.title: Expand to reattach-first
options.body: Revise this PR to reconnect and await the accepted gateway run before using fresh-session embedded fallback as a last resort.

options.title: Pause for policy decision
options.body: Leave the PR open without further repair until maintainers choose the accepted-disconnect recovery behavior in the related issue.

recommendation.title: Land the narrow isolation fix
recommendation.body: After breaking the import cycle, preserve recook-first for now and keep https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/98200 as the canonical reattach-first policy discussion.
